    The Euler characteristic of the cocycle complex #

    For a family F of relations and representations X, Y killed by it, the complex ⊕ᵢ Hom(Xᵢ, Yᵢ) → ⊕_α Hom(X_{s α}, Y_{t α}) → ⊕_r Hom(X_{s r}, Y_{t r}) (coboundaries, then relation blocks) has cohomology Hom(X, Y), H¹ (cocycles modulo coboundaries) and H² (the cokernel of the block map). Its Euler characteristic is the bilinear form of F (euler_cocycle_complex): dim Hom - dim H¹ + dim H² = Σᵢ xᵢ yᵢ - Σ_α x_{s α} y_{t α} + Σ_r x_{s r} y_{t r}.
